nodes.name: GetCartRequest
nodes.description: gRPC request selecting the user's cart in the cart service.

nodes.name: Cart returned by CartService.GetCart
nodes.description: Cart returned to checkout with the user's product ids and quantities.

nodes.name: ChargeRequest
nodes.description: Total and credit card details sent to PaymentService.Charge.

nodes.name: IProductCheckout response
nodes.description: Order result with each item's product hydrated from the catalog before being returned as JSON.

nodes.name: Order confirmation email payload
nodes.description: JSON {email, order} POSTed to the email service /send_order_confirmation endpoint.

nodes.name: EmptyCartRequest
nodes.description: gRPC request checkout sends to empty the user's cart after shipping.

nodes.name: OrderItem list
nodes.description: Each cart item paired with its product price converted to the user's currency.

nodes.name: OrderResult
nodes.description: Assembled order id, tracking id, localized shipping cost, shipping address and order items.

nodes.name: Order total Money
nodes.description: Localized shipping cost plus each item cost multiplied by its quantity.

nodes.name: ChargeResponse transaction id
nodes.description: Transaction id returned by the payment service and recorded on the order span.

nodes.name: PlaceOrderResponse (Go)
nodes.description: PlaceOrderResponse wrapping the assembled OrderResult and returned over gRPC.

nodes.name: PlaceOrderRequest body
nodes.description: Order payload posted to /api/checkout: session user, address, selected currency and card details.

nodes.name: PlaceOrderResponse (gRPC)
nodes.description: OrderResult returned by CheckoutService.PlaceOrder through CheckoutGateway.

nodes.name: Localized shipping cost
nodes.description: Shipping quote converted to the user's currency via CurrencyService.Convert.

nodes.name: Shipping quote request
nodes.description: JSON {address, items} POSTed to the shipping service /get-quote endpoint.

nodes.name: Shipping quote cost_usd
nodes.description: USD shipping quote returned by the shipping service.

nodes.name: Ship-order request
nodes.description: JSON {address, items} POSTed to the shipping service /ship-order endpoint after payment.

nodes.name: Ship-order tracking id
nodes.description: tracking_id returned by the shipping service.

nodes.name: Checkout form submit
nodes.description: CheckoutForm's Place Order submit calls onSubmit with the shipping address and credit card values.

nodes.name: CheckoutService.PlaceOrder gRPC method
nodes.description: gRPC method registered on the Go checkout server that starts the PlaceOrder orchestration.

nodes.name: POST /api/checkout
nodes.description: Next.js API route that forwards the order to the checkout gRPC service and hydrates the returned items with product catalog data.

nodes.name: Frontend checkout API
nodes.description: POST route calls CheckoutGateway.placeOrder, maps payment errors, and hydrates order items via ProductCatalogService.

nodes.name: CheckoutService PlaceOrder
nodes.description: Read cart, price and quote, charge, ship, empty cart, assemble OrderResult, email confirmation and publish to Kafka.

nodes.name: Submit checkout form
nodes.description: Form values plus session user and selected currency become the PlaceOrderRequest body posted to /api/checkout.

nodes.name: IFormData
nodes.description: Shipping address and payment form values submitted by CheckoutForm.

nodes.name: POST /api/checkout request
nodes.description: HTTP request body (PlaceOrderRequest) and currencyCode query parameter received by the Next.js route.

nodes.name: PlaceOrderRequest (gRPC)
nodes.description: Order request received by the Go CheckoutService from the frontend gateway.

nodes.name: Product from ProductCatalogService
nodes.description: Product detail loaded for an order item and the selected currency during response hydration.

nodes.name: Cart hash expiry
nodes.description: Writing an empty cart to Valkey refreshes the user's hash with a 60-minute TTL.

nodes.name: Email request timeout
nodes.description: The order confirmation POST uses a one-second context timeout; a failure is only logged and does not fail the order.

nodes.name: EmitRawPii feature flag
nodes.description: When EmitRawPii is enabled, PlaceOrder records the user email, card number and CVV as span attributes.

nodes.name: Kafka publish condition
nodes.description: OrderResult is published only when KAFKA_ADDR is set; the topic comes from KAFKA_TOPIC and defaults to 'orders'.

nodes.name: KafkaQueueProblems overload flag
nodes.description: A positive KafkaQueueProblems flag re-publishes the OrderResult message additional times to simulate queue overload.

nodes.name: Money validation
nodes.description: money.Sum rejects invalid Money values and mismatched currency codes; Must turns that error into a panic during total computation.

nodes.name: Payment decline mapping
nodes.description: A gRPC error starting with 'failed to charge card:' (except Unavailable/Internal) returns HTTP 422 with code PAYMENT_FAILED; other failures return HTTP 500.

nodes.name: PaymentUnreachable feature flag
nodes.description: When PaymentUnreachable is enabled, CheckoutService sends Charge to badAddress:50051 instead of the configured payment service.

nodes.name: POST-only checkout route
nodes.description: Only POST is handled by /api/checkout; any other method returns HTTP 405.

nodes.name: orders Kafka topic
nodes.description: Kafka orders topic carrying the protobuf-serialized OrderResult when a broker is configured.

nodes.name: Valkey cart hashes
nodes.description: Cart protobuf stored in the 'cart' field of a Valkey hash keyed by user id.

edges.description: CheckoutForm's onSubmit in CartDetail calls placeOrder, which POSTs the order to /api/checkout via ApiGateway.
The API route calls CheckoutGateway.placeOrder, which invokes CheckoutService.PlaceOrder over gRPC.

edges.note: CartService.GetCart looks up the Valkey hash keyed by user_id and its 'cart' field.
For each cart item GetProduct returns price_usd, which is converted to userCurrency into OrderItem.cost.
Prepared order items are placed in OrderResult.Items.
Cart items become the JSON 'items' of the /get-quote payload.
Cart items become JSON 'items' of the POST /ship-order payload.
PaymentService.Charge returns transaction_id, recorded in the span.
CartService.EmptyCart writes an empty serialized Cart into the user's Valkey cart field.
Each item cost is multiplied by its quantity and summed into the total.
Assembled OrderResult becomes the 'order' key of the confirmation payload.
OrderResult is wrapped as PlaceOrderResponse.Order for the gRPC reply.
OrderResult is protobuf-marshalled and published as the Kafka message value (topic defaults to 'orders').
Computed total becomes ChargeRequest.amount.
The PlaceOrderRequest body posted by ApiGateway is received by the route; selectedCurrency is additionally sent as the currencyCode query parameter.
Order fields pass through; each ordered item's product is fetched and attached before JSON response.
Localized shipping quote becomes OrderResult.ShippingCost.
Shipping cost starts the running Money total.
POST /get-quote response body is unmarshalled into cost_usd Money.
CurrencyService.Convert converts cost_usd to req.userCurrency.
POST /ship-order response body is unmarshalled into tracking_id.
Tracking id becomes OrderResult.ShippingTrackingId.
Form address and card fields map into Address and CreditCardInfo; session userId and selectedCurrency are added.
Request body is forwarded via CheckoutGateway.placeOrder; the gRPC response carries the assembled OrderResult.
req.UserId becomes GetCartRequest.UserId.
Request credit card details are copied into ChargeRequest.credit_card.
req.Email becomes the 'email' key of the email service JSON payload.
req.UserId becomes EmptyCartRequest.UserId after shipping.
New UUID and request Address populate OrderResult.OrderId and ShippingAddress.
Request Address becomes the JSON 'address' of the /get-quote payload.
Request Address becomes JSON 'address' of the POST /ship-order payload.
Product from ProductCatalogService.getProduct(productId, currencyCode) becomes items[].item.product.
Serialized Cart protobuf is parsed and its product_id/quantity items are returned to checkout.
